metadata.question: Was there an algae bloom visible off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10,  2015?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: MODIS Aqua L3SMI daily chlorophyll-a (NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI), on 2015-10-10 over an offshore rectangle west of Santa Monica. If empty, widen to ±3 days (2015-10-07 to 2015-10-13). If still empty, fallback to Landsat 8 L2 within ±3 days and compute FAI; if L8 empty, try Landsat 7 L2.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- MODIS L3SMI is already processed; just count valid pixels. For Landsat L2, apply QA_PIXEL cloud/shadow/cirrus/snow mask.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- C1: No images found even after recovery steps.
- C2: Collections exist but valid pixel count after masking is 0.
- C3: Any computed statistic is null/NaN or outside plausible range (chlor_a <= 0 or > 1000; FAI outside [-0.5, 0.5]).
- A/B: If valid stats exist. MODIS decision: mean chlor_a > 3 mg/m3 or p90 > 5 mg/m3 => A. Otherwise B. If MODIS unavailable, Landsat FAI decision: mean > 0.005 or p90 > 0.01 => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-118.60, 33.95, -118.45, 34.05]); // Offshore Santa Monica Bay
  const dayStart = '2015-10-10';
  const dayEnd = '2015-10-11';
  const winStart = '2015-10-07';
  const winEnd = '2015-10-13';

  let finalTag = 'D';
  try {
    // 2. MODIS Aqua L3SMI chlorophyll-a
    let modis = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI')
      .filterDate(dayStart, dayEnd)
      .filterBounds(aoi)
      .select('chlor_a');
    let modisCountDay = await modis.size().getInfo();
    console.log('MODIS daily images: ' + modisCountDay);
    if (modisCountDay === 0) {
      modis = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI')
        .filterDate(winStart, winEnd)
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .select('chlor_a');
      const modisCountWin = await modis.size().getInfo();
      console.log('MODIS ±3d images: ' + modisCountWin);
    }
    const modisSize = await modis.size().getInfo();

    if (modisSize > 0) {
      const modisImg = modis.median().clip(aoi);
      const mCount = await modisImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: 4000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('chlor_a').getInfo();
      const mMean = await modisImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: 4000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('chlor_a').getInfo();
      const mP90 = await modisImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.percentile([90]),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: 4000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('chlor_a_p90').getInfo();

      console.log(`MODIS chlor_a mean: ${mMean !== null ? mMean.toFixed(3) : 'null'} mg/m3, p90: ${mP90 !== null ? mP90.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, pixels: ${mCount}`);

      if (!isFinite(mCount) || mCount === 0) {
        // Try Landsat fallback; if that also yields no valid pixels, C2.
      } else if (mMean === null || mP90 === null || !isFinite(mMean) || !isFinite(mP90) || mMean <= 0 || mMean > 1000 || mP90 <= 0 || mP90 > 1000) {
        console.log('MODIS chlor_a invalid.');
        finalTag = 'C3';
        console.log(finalTag);
        return;
      } else {
        // Decision with MODIS
        finalTag = (mMean > 3 || mP90 > 5) ? 'A' : 'B';
        console.log(finalTag);
        return;
      }

      // If we reach here, MODIS had zero valid pixels -> attempt Landsat
    }

    // 3. Landsat fallback (L8 then L7), ±3 days
    function scaleL2SR(img) {
      // Apply scale and offset to SR bands
      const srBands = ['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6'];
      const scaled = img.select(srBands).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
    }
    function maskL2Clouds(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const cloudShadowBit = 1 << 3;
      const snowBit = 1 << 4;
      const cloudBit = 1 << 5;
      const cirrusBit = 1 << 7;
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBit).eq(0)
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(snowBit).eq(0))
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0))
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBit).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function addFAI(img, isL8) {
      // Use equivalent bands for L7 vs L8
      const red = img.select(isL8 ? 'SR_B4' : 'SR_B3');
      const nir = img.select(isL8 ? 'SR_B5' : 'SR_B4');
      const swir = img.select(isL8 ? 'SR_B6' : 'SR_B5');
      const wlRed = 0.655, wlNir = 0.865, wlSwir = 1.61;
      const baseline = red.add(swir.subtract(red).multiply((wlNir - wlRed) / (wlSwir - wlRed)));
      const fai = nir.subtract(baseline).rename('FAI');
      return img.addBands(fai);
    }

    let l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterDate(winStart, winEnd)
      .filterBounds(aoi)
      .map(scaleL2SR)
      .map(maskL2Clouds)
      .map(function(img){ return addFAI(img, true); });
    let l8Size = await l8.size().getInfo();
    console.log('Landsat 8 images: ' + l8Size);

    let lsColl = l8;
    let isL8 = true;

    if (l8Size === 0) {
      let l7 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterDate(winStart, winEnd)
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .map(scaleL2SR)
        .map(maskL2Clouds)
        .map(function(img){ return addFAI(img, false); });
      const l7Size = await l7.size().getInfo();
      console.log('Landsat 7 images: ' + l7Size);
      lsColl = l7;
      isL8 = false;
      if (l7Size === 0) {
        // No images for MODIS and Landsat windows
        if (modisSize === 0) {
          finalTag = 'C1';
          console.log(finalTag);
          return;
        } else {
          // MODIS had images but zero valid pixels
          finalTag = 'C2';
          console.log(finalTag);
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    // Compute median FAI and stats
    const faiImg = lsColl.select('FAI').median().clip(aoi);
    const totalCount = await ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('one').getInfo();
    const validCount = await faiImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('FAI').getInfo();
    const faiMean = await faiImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('FAI').getInfo();
    const faiP90 = await faiImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.percentile([90]),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('FAI_p90').getInfo();

    const cloudMaskedPct = (totalCount && validCount !== null) ? (100 * (1 - (validCount / totalCount))) : null;
    console.log(`Landsat valid px: ${validCount} / ${totalCount}, cloud-masked ~${cloudMaskedPct !== null ? cloudMaskedPct.toFixed(1) : 'null'}%`);
    console.log(`FAI mean: ${faiMean !== null ? faiMean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, p90: ${faiP90 !== null ? faiP90.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`);

    if (!isFinite(validCount) || validCount === 0) {
      finalTag = 'C2';
    } else if (faiMean === null || faiP90 === null || !isFinite(faiMean) || !isFinite(faiP90) || faiMean < -0.5 || faiMean > 0.5 || faiP90 < -0.5 || faiP90 > 0.5) {
      finalTag = 'C3';
    } else {
      finalTag = (faiMean > 0.005 || faiP90 > 0.010) ? 'A' : 'B';
    }
    console.log(finalTag);
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('Error: ' + e);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
